//: What a settler does for a living. Same four fields as the builder's secondary_activities,
//2: because the format was already right: a building to go to, a tool to hold, an animation,
//3: and a block inside that building's own bounding box to stand at and work.
//4: target_block is searched ONLY inside the building it belongs to, so a common block like
//5: oak_log is safe here and does not turn every wall in town into a workplace.
//6: manned_window_ticks: how long one finished shift keeps a workplace counted as manned.
//7: Longer than a shift on purpose, so a settler working steadily never flickers unmanned.
//8: unmanned_output: what a workplace WITH a job defined produces when nobody worked it.
//9: 0.5 is deliberately not 0.0 -- a hard gate would stop every existing town dead the
//10: moment this shipped, before a single settler had walked in. Set it to 0.0 when you want
//11: no worker to mean no goods, and to 1.0 to make work purely decorative again.
//12: What each level of skill adds. At max_skill 5 that is 1.75x for a master.
